ruleset.name: Teaching Assistant
ruleset.description: The teacher's short PMD list for student code: mistakes that compile and often even work, but show a gap in good practice. What javac's warnings and the Checkstyle list already catch (switch fall-through, equals without hashCode, == on strings, empty catch blocks, braces, names) is left out. Every finding goes to the grader as a fact; the grading rules decide whether it costs points. Sent into the sandbox with each check by JavaBuildCheck.
